fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant lost access to a wallet account and later noticed unauthorised transfers of Rs. 7,500. The matter was brought to Tiruppur Central PS on 2026-03-21, while the incident was placed on 2026-03-21 at roughly 09:05. The online submission was made by Dinesh Nathan (9000000420). Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Rajesh Karuppasamy, using the number 9000000318. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100084. The complaint refers to Naveen Krishnan, a driver, reachable on 9000000013. Potentially relevant material referenced includes social media screenshots. The account SYN-ACC-100084 was also referenced in FIR-2026-00268, so the two matters may be potentially related.
fields.Modus_Operandi: OTP allegedly obtained during a call before the account was accessed.
fields.Keywords: account takeover, unauthorised access, mobile number, associate, suspect, morning, receiving account, shopping complex
